purpose: Check that improved invariant readouts under cache interventions do not merely result from reverting the legitimate update of A.
scope: All original dataset/stratum/value/base-stream/cache-combination units, not just repaired cases. Preserve the original384 primary preservation readouts and192 oracle-history controls.
companion_query: For each of the384 primary mixed/natural conditions, also ask A-current using the identical mixed pre-question cache and its own isolated fork. Do not carry query/answer state from the preservation readout.
scoring: Generate once without answer constraints, maximum12 new tokens. Store exact correctness and gold3-digit NLL for both the natural left-world and right-world A-current truths. For A-axis strata these truths differ, so report both rather than assigning a unique natural truth to a mixed cache. For the C-axis stratum they coincide. Never choose the better truth per observation.
calibration: For every natural endpoint, compare the companion cached readout with its own stored full-prefill reference and own-world truth. Any right-world score for a left endpoint is a secondary explicit counterfactual score, not a new baseline failure.
joint_report: For each intervention versus the natural right endpoint, report preservation rescues/regressions alongside right-world A-current rescues/regressions and joint both-correct counts. Separate cases where restoring the invariant answer also loses the legitimate current update.
historical_query_caveat: The A0 tail repeats the old A value near the question; A1 replaces that redundant recent evidence with the new value. Initial-A regression alone can reflect version selection or removal of redundant recent evidence, not irreversible destruction. Protected B has identical evidence and age across every tail cell and remains the cleaner unrelated-fact test.
interpretation: These remain localization controls rather than a proposed repair method. Keep the prior mixed-cache compatibility caveat, replication gate, all-row reporting and architecture baselines.
implementation_status: Addendum only; no event-path data generation or model inference has occurred.
